scope: 教员：本轮核心产品优化与公开源码发布
implemented: 倾听与可纠正的三层目标
12个有出处且保留历史边界的思想解释维度
标准引用及实际采用来源
用户确认的行动状态与反馈
议题管理、显式跨议题记忆、临时对话
停止、删除与旧流并发隔离
可独立初始化的公开资料库

public_checkout.skip_reason: 可选本地完整PDF/OCR集成；公开仓库不含这些资产

checks: direct conversation entry and secondary research tools
layered understanding and exact clickable references
actions require explicit acceptance attempts and feedback
rename is text safe and remembered issues remain explicit
archive restore and structured export
listening does not create or execute another action
a new issue uses remembered context only after selection
temporary conversations keep context without browser or server history
stopping a stream allows an immediate new question
mobile notes drawers and compact research menu
deleting an issue clears server state memory and local cache
account isolation and logout have no uncaught browser errors
login page desktop and mobile layout
registration and ordinary login
research question, local evidence, network disabled
history restore and follow-up context
network enabled gives candidate evidence
historical mode requires cutoff and disables external search
history restores mode and cutoff
modern mode question
generation failure is visible and allows retry
stop generation and continue
workspace mobile layout, sidebar and evidence drawer
logout, invalid password, relogin
same-browser user isolation
admin login, configuration validation and save
admin lock revokes sessions, blocks login, unlock restores access and saved config serves questions
admin mobile layout and logout
no uncaught browser script errors
real listening respects a request not to assign an action
real advice separates goals and creates only a proposal
user explicitly accepts the action
shortening a reply preserves the stage goal and user action state
user authorizes the issue as a memory
authorized memory supports a temporary real conversation without a saved transcript
action feedback export and deletion remain controlled by the user

manual_review: 阶段目标、资源约束及人数未知保持一致
350字以内分析与200字、三句话压缩符合要求
引用可独立追溯，现代类比不冒充历史原话
real_provider_acceptance.raw_transcripts: 仅保存在本机忽略目录，不发布

release_inventory.scope: Git实际索引内容，包括DOCX XML；凭据、私有状态、home路径及体积检查

limits: 真实模型验收为有限合成场景，不能证明所有建议的语义质量或长期陪伴效果
本轮实现核心交互，用户研究、长期效果评估与其他后续阶段仍按产品方案推进
临时对话不保存于本应用；所配置模型及启用搜索服务的数据处理由其服务安排决定
